title: Pael's Legion
description: Doubles [gold]Block[/gold] gained from a card, then goes to sleep for [blue]2[/blue] turns.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: This relic doubles the block gained from any card played while active. After a card with block is played, it enters a 2-turn cooldown state (sleeping) before becoming active again. Summons a pet creature that plays animations based on the relic's state (BlockTrigger when doubling, SleepTrigger when cooling down, WakeUpTrigger when reactivating).
